# Static AI Block

> Free copy-paste AI blocks for any static website. Each block is plain HTML and JavaScript that calls OneTag AI (https://onetagai.com/llms.txt) from the browser: one script tag, no backend. Paste a block into a page and replace YOUR_ONETAG_KEY with a free key (POST {"email"} to https://onetagai.com/api/signup; the key arrives by email). This key is designed to be public: it ships in the HTML like an analytics ID.

## Blocks

- [Summarize this page](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/summarize-page.html): Summarize this page in one click.
- [Ask this page](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/ask-this-page.html): Ask anything about this page and get an answer that cites its sources.
- [Chat](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/chat.html): A full AI chat with streaming Markdown, code blocks, saved conversations, retry, stop, voice input and feedback.
- [FAQ bot](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/faq-bot.html): Answers only from your FAQ, says "I don't know" otherwise.
- [Chat launcher](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/chat-launcher.html): A floating chat button in the corner that answers visitors from the page they are on.
- [Rewrite](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/rewrite.html): Improve, fix or restyle any text, then review the changes before you accept them.
- [Translate this page](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/translate-page.html): Translate the whole page in place, or show the translation under the original.
- [Draft a reply](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/draft-reply.html): Paste a message, get a reply in the tone you pick.
- [Autocomplete](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/autocomplete.html): Ghost-text suggestions while you type; press Tab to accept.
- [Extract to JSON](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/extract-json.html): Turn messy text into structured fields.
- [Smart search](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/smart-search.html): Search a list in plain words; matches light up.
- [Explain any selection](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/explain-selection.html): Select any text on the page to explain, simplify or translate it.
- [Page actions](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/page-actions.html): Copy this page as Markdown, or open it in ChatGPT or Claude. Uses no key and no tokens.
- [Read aloud](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/read-aloud.html): Listen to the page, or to a short AI summary of it.
- [Voice input](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/voice-input.html): Dictate with the microphone, then let AI tidy the transcript.
- [Describe an image](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/describe-image.html): Get alt text for any image.
- [Quiz from this page](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/quiz.html): Turn this page into a three-question quiz.
- [Explain code](https://aiblock.onetagai.com/blocks/code-explain.html): Adds an Explain button to every code block.

## By use

- Docs: Ask this page, Page actions, Explain code, Explain any selection, Summarize this page, Translate this page, Chat launcher, FAQ bot, Read aloud, Quiz from this page
- Shop: Ask this page, Chat launcher, Smart search, FAQ bot, Translate this page, Chat, Describe an image, Extract to JSON
- Landing page: FAQ bot, Chat launcher, Ask this page, Chat, Translate this page, Extract to JSON
- Blog: Summarize this page, Ask this page, Translate this page, Read aloud, Page actions, Explain any selection, Chat launcher, Explain code, Quiz from this page, Describe an image
- Tools: Chat, Rewrite, Draft a reply, Autocomplete, Voice input, Extract to JSON, Describe an image
